# Amtech Systems Announces Participation in LD Micro Investor Conference on October 20, 2026


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f6786823eb7f4e291587cc4c1872efd6/amtechsystems/news/2026-10-06_Amtech_Systems_Announces_Participation_in_LD_404.pdf) October 06, 2026 9:00 am EDT


*Management to Discuss "More than Moore for Amtech," which Addresses the Company’s Position Amid Strong Demand for AI-Driven Advanced Packaging*


TEMPE, Ariz.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Amtech Systems, Inc. ("Amtech") (NASDAQ: ASYS), a manufacturer of equipment and consumables enabling AI semiconductor device packaging and advanced substrate fabrication, today announced it will participate in the LD Micro Main Event XX investor conference on October 20, 2026. The conference is being held at the Luxe Hotel in Los Angeles. This will be an in-person conference with Amtech presenting on Tuesday, October 20, 2026 at 3:30 PM PST in Track 1 and hosting 1:1 meetings with investors throughout the day.


The investor presentation to be referenced during the conference will be made available within the investor relations section of Amtech’s website on the morning of the event. To access the slideshow presentation, please[click here](https://www.amtechsystems.com/investors/investor-presentations) . The presentation at the conference will be webcast, please[click here](https://ldmicroevents.com/) . For those attending the conference who wish to schedule a one-on-one meeting with Amtech, please make a request with the event host or contact Amtech’s investor relations representative, Jordan Darrow of Darrow Associates, using the contact information provided in this press release.


**About Amtech Systems, Inc.**


Amtech Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ: ASYS) provides equipment, consumables and services for AI semiconductor device packaging and advanced wafer substrate fabrication. Our products include advanced packaging and electronics assembly equipment for applications such as AI GPUs and advanced automotive electronics. Consumable and other solutions are used in fabricating semiconductor devices, such as silicon carbide (SiC) and silicon (Si) power devices, digital and analog devices, power electronic packages, advanced semiconductor packages and electronic assemblies. We sell these products to semiconductor device and module manufacturers worldwide, particularly in Asia, North America and Europe.
